title: SkyrimNet Fill Her Up Inflation Awareness
tagline: The narrator sees the swelling and the release.
description: LLM trigger cues for Fill Her Up inflation level changes: swelling (level up) and release (level down), read from FHU's own per-actor state. Source-agnostic by design: the cues describe only the visible state and never assert what caused it, so any framework that feeds FHU benefits automatically.
author: regalrascal
